parts.description: A flat, rectangular white ceramic tray with raised edges and a single loop handle on one end. It features a smooth, matte finish typical of stoneware or porcelain.

Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) is enabled because the tray's thin walls and base are susceptible to tunneling effects in physics engines if subjected to high velocities or stacked under heavy loads. Contact offset is set to a standard 0.002m for PhysX stability, with a rest offset of 0.0m to maintain visual fidelity at contact.
